sectors.ai: Indonesia's tech sector lags the US rally, but the 2.27% aggregate gain and ALERT signal suggest catch-up potential. Prioritize exposure to US-listed semiconductor and AI plays (MU, LRCX, MSFT) via ETFs or direct holdings, as they drive global momentum and will likely spill over to Indonesian tech proxies in cloud and data center plays.
